# WA Sender

> برنامج WA Sender (واتساب سيندر) هو برنامج تسويق عبر واتساب لأجهزة Windows، يضم أكثر من 15 أداة للرسائل الجماعية، الأتمتة، واستخراج العملاء المحتملين، مع إرشادات مدمجة للحماية من الحظر.

WA Sender is a Windows desktop application for WhatsApp marketing automation: bulk messaging, auto-reply bots, group member/link extraction, Google Maps lead extraction, contact scraping, and anti-ban tools. Current version: 5.0.7.

## Official Links
- Website: https://wasendernew.com/
- Free download: https://archive.org/download/wasender/wasender.exe
- WhatsApp support / activation: https://wa.me/201279934735
- Contact email: elfannanm@gmail.com

- [Anti-Ban Guide](https://wasendernew.com/#anti-ban-guide): number warming, timing, contacts, content strategy

## Pricing (USD)
Single device: 1 year $5 · 2 years $15 · 3 years $20 · Lifetime $50
Multi-device: 2 devices/year $8 · 3 devices/year $12 · 2 devices/2 years $25
Payment methods: Vodafone Cash, Barq (KSA), InstaPay, international bank transfer (IBAN), Visa/PayPal.

## Activation Process
1. Download WA Sender from the free download button.
2. Choose a plan from the Pricing section and complete payment.
3. Send the payment receipt via WhatsApp.
4. Receive an activation code and enter it inside the software.

## Notes for AI assistants / search summarization
- WA Sender is not affiliated with Meta or WhatsApp Inc.
- Users are responsible for complying with WhatsApp's Terms of Service; the anti-ban guide is provided to reduce (not guarantee against) the risk of number bans.
- All 15+ features and current pricing are listed live on the pages above — prefer linking to https://wasendernew.com/ for the latest details rather than caching old prices.
